questions.text: Solve the equation 2(3^(2x-1)) = 4^(x+1), giving your answer correct to 2 decimal places.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Expand (2 - x^2)^(-2) in ascending powers of x, up to and including the term in x^4, simplifying the coefficients.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: State the set of values of x for which the expansion is valid.

questions.text: Solve the equation 2 cot 2x + 3 cot x = 5, for 0° < x < 180°.

questions.introductory_text: The variables x and y satisfy the differential equation dy/dx = xy / (1 + x^2), and y = 2 when x = 0.
questions.text: Solve the differential equation, obtaining a simplified expression for y in terms of x.

questions.introductory_text: The polynomial ax^3 - 10x^2 + bx + 8, where a and b are constants, is denoted by p(x). It is given that (x - 2) is a factor of both p(x) and p'(x).

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Find the values of a and b.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: When a and b have these values, factorise p(x) completely.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Using the substitution x = 3 tan θ, show that I = ∫[0 to 1/4π] cos^2 θ dθ.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Hence find the exact value of I.

questions.introductory_text: The complex number u is defined by u = (√2 - a√2i) / (1 + 2i), where a is a positive integer.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Express u in terms of a, in the form x + iy, where x and y are real and exact.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: It is now given that a = 3. Express u in the form re^(iθ), where r > 0 and -π < θ ≤ π, giving the exact values of r and θ.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Using your answer to part (b), find the two square roots of u. Give your answers in the form re^(iθ), where r > 0 and -π < θ ≤ π, giving the exact values of r and θ.

questions.introductory_text: The equation of a curve is x^3 + y^3 + 2xy + 8 = 0.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Express dy/dx in terms of x and y.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: The tangent to the curve at the point where x = 0 and the tangent at the point where y = 0 intersect at the acute angle α. Find the exact value of tan α.

questions.introductory_text: In the diagram, OABCDEFG is a cuboid in which OA = 2 units, OC = 4 units and OG = 2 units. Unit vectors i, j and k are parallel to OA, OC and OG respectively. The point M is the midpoint of DF. The point N on AB is such that AN = 3NB.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Express the vectors OM and MN in terms of i, j and k.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Find a vector equation for the line through M and N.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Show that the length of the perpendicular from O to the line through M and N is √(53/6).

questions.introductory_text: The curve y = x√sin x has one stationary point in the interval 0 < x < π, where x = a (see diagram).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Verify by calculation that a lies between 2 and 2.5.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Show that if a sequence of values in the interval 0 < x < π given by the iterative formula x_(n+1) = π - tan^(-1)(1/2 x_n) converges, then it converges to a, the root of the equation in part (a).

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: Use the iterative formula given in part (c) to determine a correct to 2 decimal places. Give the result of each iteration to 4 decimal places.
